headline: President Clinton extended the life of the President's Council on Sustainable Development by amending the order that created it.
what_it_does: This order changes Executive Order 12852, which set up the President's Council on Sustainable Development, an advisory group. Based on the title, it extends how long the council is allowed to keep operating. No summary was provided, so the new end date and any other changes are not described here.

who_it_affects.group: Members of the President's Council on Sustainable Development
who_it_affects.how: They can keep serving on the advisory council for a longer period.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed February 25, 1999; the source does not state a separate effective date.
